captions.detailed: This 3D model represents a classic monocular laboratory microscope. It features a wide, rounded rectangular base and a straight vertical support arm in a light beige color. The optical assembly is finished in matte black, consisting of an inclined monocular eyepiece, a vertical tube, and a rotating objective turret with multiple lenses. A square black stage with silver slide clips is mounted on a cross-slide block that moves forward and backward, controlled by a small black rotating knob on the side.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a monocular laboratory microscope using CadQuery. The microscope should feature a solid beige base and support arm, a black vertical eyepiece tube, a rotatable objective turret with multiple lenses, and a square black stage. Ensure the stage can translate prismatically fore and aft on its support, the turret can rotate on its vertical axis, and the side control knob can rotate on its horizontal shaft.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope by first building the static frame (base, vertical arm, and top arm extension) using box primitives with chamfered/rounded edges. Create the optical tube and inclined eyepiece using cylinder primitives rotated and positioned relative to the top arm. Model the rotating objective turret by combining a disk with small cylinders for the lenses, and attach it via a revolute joint. Build the stage assembly from stacked black boxes with small rectangular slide clips, mounting it to the arm support using a prismatic joint for forward/backward translation, and add a small side cylinder knob connected via a revolute joint.
